$comment: Machine-readable source of the quality-scan Probed-clean figures (#4625). Each command is written for this manifest, not copied from the ledger, and is run by scripts/docs/scan-remeasure.mjs under `bash -c` with its cwd at the root of a detached worktree at $SHA, using that SHA's own instrument scripts and no node_modules. A command reads $SHA (the full sha), $SCRATCH (a per-row empty directory) and $RG (ripgrep), never origin/dev, HEAD or a branch name, and prints exactly len(figures) integers, one per line (a control with expect no-CONTROL-FAILED-line prints anything and must print a line containing CONTROL FAILED on failure). `sha` is the scan that recorded the figures and must equal the newest ledger entry that carries a Probed clean section. kind: invariant must not move, grows must not shrink, head-sample is never flagged, count moves within `tolerance` (a relative fraction, 0 is exact), control is checked against `expect`. A scan PR updates `figures` and `sha` for every element of `rows` with its ledger entry; a scoped scan does not. `docFigures` is NOT refreshed by a scan: a doc figure moves in the PR that changes the sentence, because refreshing a doc row without touching the doc would mark a stale figure unchanged for good (#4631).

rows.name: sizing: source / test lines per package (13 pairs, pinned with git ls-tree and git show)
rows.command:
# Pairs, in order: backend frontend sdk core qa-agent mcp-server signer connect cli ops ui mcp demo-merchant-mcp. # Each prints source lines, then test lines (.test. / __tests__ / .spec. split), .ts|.tsx|.mjs under packages/

/src. for p in backend frontend sdk core qa-agent mcp-server signer connect cli ops ui mcp demo-merchant-mcp; do git ls-tree -r --name-only "$SHA" "packages/$p/src" | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|mjs)$' > "$SCRATCH/sz-$p.txt" src=0; tst=0 while IFS= read -r f; do n=$(git show "$SHA:$f" | wc -l) if printf '%s' "$f" | grep -qE '\.test\.|__tests__|\.spec\.'; then tst=$((tst+n)); else src=$((src+n)); fi done < "$SCRATCH/sz-$p.txt" echo "$src"; echo "$tst" done

rows.name: contract-doc covers: misses (cited-but-not-covered), docs with a miss, contract docs
rows.command:
# This command reads the worktree; refuse to run unless the tree is exactly $SHA.
git diff --quiet "$SHA" -- || { echo "worktree is not at $SHA" >&2; exit 1; }
# The reference loop under bash with set -f; the front-matter selector reads the FIRST front-matter block only.
FM='FNR==1{c=0} /^---$/{c++; next} c==1 && /^contract: true([[:space:]]|$)/{print FILENAME; nextfile}'
set -f
docs=$(git ls-files 'docs/*.md' | xargs awk "$FM" | sort)
total=0; docswith=0; ndocs=0
for d in $docs; do
  ndocs=$((ndocs+1))
  declared=$(awk '/^---$/{c++; next} c==1' "$d" | awk '/^covers:/{f=1;next} f&&/^  - /{sub(/^  - /,"");print;next} f{f=0}' | sort -u)
  claimed=$(awk '/^---$/{c++; next} c>=2' "$d" | grep -o '`[^` ]*`' | tr -d '`' | grep -E '^(packages|scripts|\.github)/[^ ]+\.[a-z]+$' | sort -u | while read p; do git ls-files --error-unmatch "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "$p"; done)
  missing=0
  for p in $claimed; do
    hit=0
    for g in $declared; do
      case "$g" in
        *'**'*) [[ "$p" == "${g%%\*\**}"* ]] && hit=1;;
        *) [ "$p" = "$g" ] && hit=1;;
      esac
    done
    [ $hit = 0 ] && missing=$((missing+1))
  done
  total=$((total+missing)); [ $missing -gt 0 ] && docswith=$((docswith+1))
done
set +f
echo "$total"; echo "$docswith"; echo "$ndocs"

rows.command:
# This command reads the worktree; refuse to run unless the tree is exactly $SHA.
git diff --quiet "$SHA" -- || { echo "worktree is not at $SHA" >&2; exit 1; }
FM='FNR==1{c=0} /^---$/{c++; next} c==1 && /^contract: true([[:space:]]|$)/{print FILENAME; nextfile}'
CTL="$SCRATCH/fm"; mkdir -p "$CTL"
printf '%s\n' '---' 'owner: "@x"' 'status: current' 'covers:' '  - scripts/docs/**' 'last-verified: "2026-10-30"' '---' '' 'contract: true' > "$CTL/body-only.md"
printf '%s\n' '---' 'owner: "@x"' 'status: current' 'contract: true' 'covers:' '  - scripts/docs/**' 'last-verified: "2026-10-30"' '---' '' 'no key in the body' > "$CTL/front-matter.md"
awk "$FM" "$CTL/body-only.md" | grep -q . && echo "CONTROL FAILED body-only fixture selected"
awk "$FM" "$CTL/front-matter.md" | grep -q . || echo "CONTROL FAILED front-matter fixture not selected"
echo "selector fixtures checked"

rows.name: figure-bearing lines in the 25 newest CASP shards, and how many quote a command
rows.command:
# This command reads the worktree; refuse to run unless the tree is exactly $SHA.
git diff --quiet "$SHA" -- || { echo "worktree is not at $SHA" >&2; exit 1; }
R='\b[0-9]+ of [0-9]+\b|\b[0-9]+/[0-9]+\b|\b[0-9]+%|\*\*[0-9]+(\*\*|[ ,;:)]|$)|\b[0-9]+ (passed|failed|skipped|red|files|commits|tests|runs|rows|lines|hits|matches)\b'
git ls-tree --name-only "$SHA" docs/regulatory/casp-changelog/ | grep -E '/2026-[^/]*\.md$' | sort | tail -25 > "$SCRATCH/shards.txt"
[ -s "$SCRATCH/shards.txt" ] || { echo "no shards listed: $RG would search the whole tree" >&2; exit 1; }
"$RG" -n "$R" $(cat "$SCRATCH/shards.txt") | wc -l
"$RG" -n "$R" $(cat "$SCRATCH/shards.txt") | "$RG" '`(rg|grep|git|node|npm|find|ls|wc) ' | wc -l

rows.name: retired-vocabulary residue: files / historical / live
rows.command:
# This command reads the worktree; refuse to run unless the tree is exactly $SHA.
git diff --quiet "$SHA" -- || { echo "worktree is not at $SHA" >&2; exit 1; }
T='executeAllowanceTransfer|generateTransferHash|hasTokenAllowanceConfigured|decideCoverage|legacy-authorize|allowance-nonce|safe_approver_metadata|approval_requests|pendingApprovals|approval queue'
"$RG" -l -i "$T" docs packages .agents scripts -g '*.md' -g '*.ts' -g '*.tsx' -g '*.mjs' -g '*.json' -g '!node_modules' -g '!**/dist/**' -g '!.agents/skills/quality-scan/references/dimensions.md' -g '!docs/quality/scan-baselines.json' | sort > "$SCRATCH/rv-files.txt"
live=0; hist=0
while read f; do
  s=$(awk '/^---$/{c++; next} c==1 && /^status:/{print $2; exit}' "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  case "$f" in
    docs/regulatory/casp-changelog/*|docs/quality/scan-ledger.md|docs/archive/*|docs/bug-reports/*) hist=$((hist+1));;
    *) if [ -n "$s" ] && [ "$s" != "current" ]; then hist=$((hist+1)); else live=$((live+1)); fi;;
  esac
done < "$SCRATCH/rv-files.txt"
wc -l < "$SCRATCH/rv-files.txt"; echo "$hist"; echo "$live"

rows.name: copy lint: files outside SCAN_DIRS/SCAN_FILES, and how many carry hits (pinned git ls-tree and git show, #4615)
rows.command:
git ls-tree -r --name-only "$SHA" packages/frontend/src packages/sdk/src | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx)$' | grep -vE '\.test\.|__tests__|/app/|/components/|/hooks/' > "$SCRATCH/cl.txt"
node -e 'import("./scripts/frontend-copy-lint.mjs").then(async (m) => { const fs = await import("node:fs"); const cp = await import("node:child_process"); const sha = process.argv[2]; const files = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").trim().split("\n").filter((f) => !m.SCAN_FILES.includes(f)); let hit = 0; for (const f of files) { const n = m.findCopyIssues(cp.execFileSync("git", ["show", sha + ":" + f], { encoding: "utf8" })).length; if (n) hit++ } console.log(files.length); console.log(hit) })' "$SCRATCH/cl.txt" "$SHA"

rows.name: money perimeter: files calling a money verb, and how many match no money-path glob
rows.command:
# This command reads the worktree; refuse to run unless the tree is exactly $SHA.
git diff --quiet "$SHA" -- || { echo "worktree is not at $SHA" >&2; exit 1; }
"$RG" -l -e 'sendTransaction|redeemDelegation|signTypedData|sendUserOperation|executeTransaction|broadcastTransaction' packages --type ts -g '!*test*' -g '!**/dist/**' > "$SCRATCH/mv.txt"
node -e 'import("./scripts/ci/qa-freshness.mjs").then(async (q) => { const fs = await import("node:fs"); const globs = [...q.loadMoneyPathGlobs(), ...q.loadMoneyPathControlGlobs()]; const files = fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1], "utf8").trim().split("\n"); const out = files.filter((f) => !globs.some((g) => q.matchesGlob(f, g))); console.log(files.length); console.log(out.length) })' "$SCRATCH/mv.txt"

rows.name: visual gate: app routes a visual spec shoots, and total app routes
rows.command:
# This command reads the worktree; refuse to run unless the tree is exactly $SHA.
git diff --quiet "$SHA" -- || { echo "worktree is not at $SHA" >&2; exit 1; }
find packages/frontend/src/app -name 'page.tsx' | sed -E 's#packages/frontend/src/app##; s#/page\.tsx$##; s#/\([^)]*\)##g; s#^$#/#' | sort -u > "$SCRATCH/routes.txt"
"$RG" -o "'/[a-z][a-z0-9/-]*'" packages/frontend/e2e/*.visual.spec.ts | sed -E "s/.*:'([^']*)'/\1/" | sort -u > "$SCRATCH/shot.txt"
unshot=$(comm -23 "$SCRATCH/routes.txt" "$SCRATCH/shot.txt" | wc -l)
total=$(wc -l < "$SCRATCH/routes.txt")
echo $((total - unshot)); echo "$total"
